OneMed distributes over 30,000 to 50,000 medical products sourced from more
than 1,700 global and local suppliers. It carries major medical brands including its own proprietary product lines (evercare®, SELEFA®, and Embra®) alongside top external manufacturing partners like Ansell, ResMed, Philips Respironics, and Fisher & Paykel.
www.onemed.com.au
Proprietary and In-House Brands
evercare®
: Premium quality medical supplies and consumables.
SELEFA®
: Standard surgical and hospital care products.
Embra®
: Eco-friendly medical supplies focused on a lower environmental footprint.
Evercare Medical
Major Distributed Manufacturers & Partners
Ansell
: Surgical and disposable examination gloves (including GAMMEX, ENCORE, MICRO-TOUCH, and MICROFLEX).
ResMed
: CPAP and sleep apnoea diagnostic/therapy devices.
Philips Respironics
: Respiratory care and sleep management solutions.
Fisher & Paykel Healthcare
: Respiratory and acute care medical devices.
Löwenstein Medical & Yuwell
: Sleep health and respiratory support hardware.
Sunrise
: Diagnostic and mobility therapy equipment.
www.onemed.com.au
